evidence_notes: Diagnosed ten years ago. Also has ankylosing spondylitis and chronic kidney disease from NSAID use. Started Remicade for both conditions, worked initially. Switched to Humira, less effective (40%). Nephrologist concerned about stronger meds due to kidney disease. Specialists disagree on treatment. Work impossible, on disability. Lost house, divorced. Dating impossible. Loneliness crushing. Considering clinical trials but kidney disease is exclusion criteria. Surgery is an option but recovery with AS would be difficult. Contemplating ending life but parents' well-being prevents it.
